summary_en: This Phase 2 trial is testing an umbilical cord blood transplant given with cyclophosphamide, fludarabine, and total-body irradiation. It is for people aged 6 months to 65 years with high-risk blood cancers and related conditions. Drugs are given into a vein, and cyclosporine can be given by vein or by mouth. How often and for how long is not stated. The main outcome measure is not stated.
summary_es: Este ensayo de fase 2 estudia un trasplante de sangre de cordón umbilical administrado junto con ciclofosfamida, fludarabina y radiación corporal total. Está dirigido a personas de 6 meses a 65 años con cánceres de la sangre de alto riesgo y condiciones relacionadas. Los medicamentos se administran por vena, y la ciclosporina puede administrarse por vena o por vía oral. La frecuencia y la duración no se indican. El resultado principal no se indica.
who_for: Aged 6 months to 65 years at time of consent.
Acute leukemia (AML, ALL, or related types) in first or later remission, with low marrow blast levels.
Chronic myeloid leukemia in first chronic phase that did not respond to or could not tolerate tyrosine kinase inhibitor therapy.
Certain MDS, MPD, non-Hodgkin lymphoma, or BPDCN cases meeting remission or disease criteria.
Adequate performance status and kidney, liver, heart, and lung function.
not_for: Myelofibrosis or moderate-severe bone marrow fibrosis.
Prior allogeneic transplant, two prior stem cell transplants, or an autologous transplant within 12 months.
Checkpoint inhibitor use in the last 12 months.
Active uncontrolled infection or HIV infection.
Pregnancy or breastfeeding, or inability to give informed consent or follow the protocol.
